prompt: Objective: increase library card sign-ups across a county. What you've learned: 45% of residents hold a card. Latest finding: one town signs up only 15%. What is the best next step?

options.text: Compare the county's rate with other counties
options.feedback: Less useful: one town stands out.

options.text: Estimate what a sign-up drive with free gifts would cost
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing the cause.

options.text: Find out why that one town signs up so few residents
options.feedback: Right. One town stands out, so understand why.
The finding is about place, not time.

explanation: One town signs up 15% of residents against 45% countywide. Find out why.
